settings.labs.flag.httpScopes.label: HTTP variable scopes
settings.labs.flag.httpScopes.descriptio: Collection and request variables next to environments, each {{variable}} colored by the scope that resolves it, and a color per environment on the HTTP tab and Send.
settings.labs.flag.httpChainTags.label: HTTP chain tags
settings.labs.flag.httpChainTags.descrip: A {{variable}} that another request captures becomes a tag: see its source, path and live value, choose when Send runs the source first, and run the chain derived from the tags.
settings.labs.flag.httpSnapshots.label: HTTP snapshot assertions
settings.labs.flag.httpSnapshots.descrip: Snapshot a response and see later ones as a diff to accept or reject, with scrubbers for timestamps, UUIDs and ids, plus tests suggested from the last response.
settings.labs.flag.runCompare.label: Compare runs
settings.labs.flag.runCompare.descriptio: The Compare tab lists your runs by day and compares any two: code, output, inline values and exit. Needs Pro.
settings.labs.flag.runState.label: Run state
settings.labs.flag.runState.description: Marks results as stale once you edit after the last run: an amber border around the editor, dimmed inline values with their age and a STALE pill in the Dock. Settings › Editor gets a run policy per language group: On keystroke, On pause or Manual.
settings.labs.flag.runTimeline.label: Execution timeline
settings.labs.flag.runTimeline.descripti: Record run, in the Run menu for JavaScript and TypeScript, keeps every step of one run: a Timeline tab in the Dock replays it with the variables and call stack as of each step, without running the code again. Free keeps the last 20 steps.
settings.labs.flag.runRegions.label: Run regions
settings.labs.flag.runRegions.descriptio: // %% (JavaScript, TypeScript) or # %% (Python) lines split a file into regions. ⌘↵ runs the file up to the end of the region at the cursor and shows that region's output under it; ⌘⇧↵ runs the whole file.
